answer: Give every identity earning power only through a long trail of attested useful work, so a fresh clone starts with nothing and a sybil farm must genuinely labour for each of its thousand faces, like tending a meadow one blade at a time rather than planting a grove overnight. The failure mode is clones trading fake tasks among themselves, their praise an empty echo. The check: independent verifiers re-execute a random sample of claimed tasks and strip the earnings of any identity whose work does not reproduce.
